curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Can an impoverished singer paralyzed by crippling nerves command the spotlight long enough to reshape 20th-century music?
curatedMovie.description: Raised in a Belleville brothel and hardened by Parisian streets, young Edith Piaf confronts intense stage fright after nightclub owner Louis Leplée discovers her singular voice in 1935.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Heavy, passionate, and measured; an engaged French-language portrait ideal for solitary, focused viewing.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Olivier Dahan stages the rise of an immortal musical icon as a raw, emotionally heavy drama anchored in the sheer grit required to survive and sing.
